caption: The drawing is done in black ink on an off-white background. It depicts a glass dome or bell jar placed on a round, flat base. Inside the dome, there are two cylindrical objects that resemble candles, both standing upright. The taller cylinder has a slightly rounded top with two short protrusions emerging from it, while the shorter cylinder leans slightly next to it and is partially obscured by the taller one. The glass dome has vertical lines suggesting transparency and highlights, with an arched top that features an ornamental ring or hook suspended from the upper center. Shading and line work are used to indicate depth, texture, and the roundness of both the dome and the objects inside. At the bottom of the drawing, there is handwritten text: "CASA ROBIE" and "WM HOFFMAN."
title: Candle Holder
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
